phase: Bounded current-first-party research and disposition only
scopeBoundary: Research/disposition only. No seat transcription, Human Pass, venue-source creation, production integration, generated catalog/runtime, fingerprint, application code, validator, or existing production data was touched. venues:build was deliberately not run. policyBasis: ADOPT requires a current facility identity, current first-party seat material, an issuer-defined representative configuration, and direct lossless ownership of every required area/row/seat identifier. A chart alone is insufficient: blank-cell interpolation, neighbouring-row propagation, alignment-derived ownership, geometry/symmetry completion, pitch-based completion and capacity fitting are all prohibited. Machine structure is a future independent checksum only, never an identifier source.

livePoolReconstruction.rankingAdjustment: Evidence-yield recovery. Because the previous batch returned 0 ADOPT from eight dedicated-theatre-first candidates, the ranking stopped treating "dedicated theatre" as sufficient for the top tier. Tier A required high current performance value AND a positive evidence signal (a current issuer seat-map link, a downloads/technical section carrying audience material, explicit fixed/standard-seating wording, per-floor or per-area seat subtotals, continuing assigned-seat sale, or issuer/sibling precedent); civic performance halls (大ホール/主ホール/メインホール and proper-noun halls) were ranked level with dedicated theatres inside that tier. Tier B was high performance value with unknown evidence. Tier C (flat floor, free seating, freely arranged movable chairs, rental/studio/rehearsal/meeting rooms, maximum-capacity-only wording) was deprioritised. Unknown capacity and absent stored URL stayed neutral. Lightweight issuer discovery was used only to order the full-research queue, never to dispose of a candidate.

venues.identifierCompleteness: FAIL. The wrestling chart prints an individual number on every position but carries no row label anywhere: its only alphabetic labels are the five side-stand column letters A–E on each side, and the 北側 ringside grid repeats 1–36 across five unlabelled rows, so numbers alone are not unique keys and rows would have to be created from vertical position. The boxing chart is much richer — 北側 rows A–K, 南側 rows A–R and 東側/西側 columns A–E all print their letters on both sides of each block with individual seat numbers — but its ringside blocks い・ろ・は・に repeat on all four sides of the ring with the same (label, number) keys, and no ringside block carries a printed 側 owner. The four 側 captions sit at the page margins beside the stands; assigning the ringside blocks to them would be alignment-derived ownership, which is prohibited.
venues.configurationCompleteness: The issuer does directly define two representative configurations and calls them 基本パターン, so movability is not the blocker. The blocker is that neither configuration yields a complete direct identifier set.
venues.issuerTotalAndMappedTarget: No issuer numbered-seat subtotal, per-block subtotal or whole-room total was found on the seat page, the hall pages or the FAQ. Nothing usable as a mapped target exists, and no total may be inferred from the drawings.
venues.structuralCheckPath: Vector cell geometry with printed-number occupancy (wrestling) and raster seat-cell components with row-band profiling (boxing) would both be feasible independent checksums later, but neither can supply the missing row or sector ownership.
venues.reopenCondition: Issuer publishes a complete numbered chart or per-seat list in which every position — ringside blocks included — carries a directly printed area/row/seat identity.
